content.comment_body: Can an average [product_name] input operate as PNP or NPN? The [product_name] and related modules can function as either PNP or NPN, depending on configuration. Is it possible to switch between PNP or NPN input modes directly through the device display or using [product_name] programming software? Appreciate any advice.

When using the [product_name] in NPN configuration, you should connect supply voltage to terminals P1 and P2 as follows: P1 connects to M (or 0V) and P2 to +24VDC. Please refer to the attached diagram for more details.

NPN sensors can be connected directly to the digital inputs of [product_name]. However, some 2-wire sensors may not function well if the input resistor is too high—refer to the sensor manual for specifics. If you encounter issues with 2-wire sensors, you can add an extra resistor between the digital input and the negative side of the power supply. PNP sensors can also be used, but you must include an additional resistor between the positive supply and the digital input, with the sensor placed between the digital input and the supply negative. Note that in this setup, the input signal will be inverted, but this can be handled easily in your program.

The responses clarify that this behavior is set by wiring, not by software, and detail how to physically wire inputs and sensors, including the use of extra resistors if compatibility issues arise. Manuals should be referenced for wiring details, as software-based configuration is not available for this function.
